test_cases.name: new_product_scroll
test_cases.input: Build a John-WebsiteScrollAnima-Ver1 product scroll for a black ceramic cup. Chapters: whole, lip, exploded, side, buy.
assertions: Creates a sticky 100dvh pin inside a tall track and eases progress with requestAnimationFrame at 0.18
Uses beat holds with plateaus, not a linear map from scroll to time
Runs knockout_black.py and does not crop the stills
Puts ghost type, ripples, both marquees, spine, and rail behind the product on #070707
Places exploded-part labels only on the right, one per piece, with a dashed leader
Does not restyle an existing hero

test_cases.name: fix_empty_and_black_plate
test_cases.input: The scroll feels empty and the bottle photo has a black background covering the motion graphics. Use John-WebsiteScrollAnima-Ver1.
assertions: Knocks out the studio plate with knockout_black.py while keeping canvas size
Adds the motion field from references/motion-field.md instead of more paragraphs
Does not switch the stage to white

test_cases.name: fix_wall_labels
test_cases.input: On 02 The Wall the part labels look off and overlap the paragraph. Fix them in the John-WebsiteScrollAnima-Ver1 style.
assertions: Removes labels from the left column
Aligns each label vertically with its piece on the right
Gives each label a name, a short caption, and a leader whose length matches the piece width
Deletes the right-hand paragraph that repeats the part names
